description: This file is an Alembic migration script that modifies database schema to replace integer IDs with UUIDs across multiple tables, including creating extensions, adding new columns, populating data, and managing constraints.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema migration to replace integer IDs with UUIDs, including creating extensions, adding columns, populating data, and updating constraints.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the schema changes made in upgrade, restoring integer IDs and associated constraints.
